title: Select sparse available positions
description: Let users select any currently available positions and skip unavailable ones through a semantic keyboard-operable grid or list without implicit reassignment or reordering.
acceptanceCriteria: Available positions can be selected individually in canonical TASK-47 order
Unavailable positions are identified by stable label and reason and cannot be selected
Sparse selection preserves exact position identities and does not compact assignments
Selection supports keyboard operation, visible focus, associated status, and non-coordinate labels
Reload preserves the same selected position identities and order

steps.details: Store selected stable position identities separately from assignment content and validate each identity against canonical positions and current availability.
Reuse the sheet preview/list seam to expose checkbox-like position controls with row/column names, availability reason, visible focus, and announced count/status.
Ensure toggling or encountering an unavailable position never moves another assignment; report stale selections instead of silently substituting positions.
Select non-adjacent positions by keyboard, attempt an unavailable position, reload, and assert identities, labels, order, and assignments remain unchanged.

technicalNotes: Keep the ten-minute UI increment to existing semantic controls and one sparse-selection flow.
Unavailable means unavailable in the current software plan; persistent physical sheet usage is deferred to PRD 23.
